title: Brilliant
name: Rohit Sharma
text: Camera is excellent in daylight and the display is very bright. Battery backup is good, easily lasts a full day. Using it for 2 months now, no issues.

title: Not good
name: Aman Verma
text: Phone heats up a lot while playing BGMI. After 3 months the battery drains very fast. Not happy with the performance for gaming.

title: Worst experience
name: Neha
text: The phone stopped working after 4 months. Went to the service centre and they took 12 days for the repair. Worst service.

title: Value for money
name: Suresh K
text: Bought this for my mother. Good value for money, sound is loud and clear. Display is nice for watching videos.

title: Okay phone
name: Priya
text: After the latest update the phone hangs sometimes and the camera app lags. Display is good though.

title: Heating issue
name: Vikram
text: Heavy heating while gaming, PUBG and COD both make it hot. Battery drains in 4 hours of games. Not worth it for gamers.

title: Awesome
name: Karan
text: Using this phone for 3 months, performance is smooth and the camera is awesome. Better than my old Redmi Note 10 in every way.

title: Good
name: Anjali
text: Nice phone for my father, basic use like calls and WhatsApp. Battery is good and the build feels solid.

title: Dead
name: Mohit
text: Display got a green line after 2 months and then the phone died completely. Replacement took 15 days.

title: Good camera
name: Sneha
text: Photos are great and the selfie camera is good. Charging is fast. Using it for 1 month.
